column1: # The known disagreements between this crate and the reference checker on
# damaged images (#164): scripts/differential-fuzz.sh fails on any class of
# disagreement not listed here. One class a line, tab-separated:
# - direction: `ref-only` (the reference found something this crate called
#   clean) or `ours-only` (this crate found something the reference did not).
# - signature: what was found, as the run's report prints it: the
#   reference's first finding with its numbers folded to `#` for ref-only,
# - note: the issue that tracks it, or why it is not a defect.
# A line is added only from a measured run's report, never by guess. When a
# fix removes a class, its line goes in the same pull request.
